title: Application.
officialText:
Combustible materials installed on or embedded in floors of buildings of Type I or II construction shall comply
with Sections 805.1.1 through 805.1.4.
Exception: Stages and platforms constructed in accordance with Sections 410.3 and 410.4, respectively.
